title: Posts from one document
summary: Short posts for your channels, each taken from one document you choose.
text: Read the company file [doc] and write [count] short posts from it, each on a different point and each able to stand alone. Use only what the document says: do not add facts, figures or promises that are not in it. Write them in our brand voice, as drafts only. Nothing is posted anywhere; the owner reads and approves them first.
